label: sdc02_0070_fairybb_02
text: *whisper whisper*\nYou didn’t have any trouble finding the place?[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0070_select_01
text: It was fine!

label: sdc02_0070_select_02
text: *whisper whisper*

label: sdc02_0070_fairybb_03
text: *whisper whisper*\nI’m so glad to hear it![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0070_fairybb_04
text: *whisper whisper*\nSay again? I didn’t quite catch that![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0070_teacher_01
text: Alola, everybody! Shall we get started?

label: sdc02_0070_teacher_02
text: Looks like we have a new face here with us\ntoday!

label: sdc02_0070_teacher_03
text: I’m sure you’re all enjoying the tropical clime\nwe’ve re-created here at the Coastal Biome.

label: sdc02_0070_teacher_04
text: But remember—it’s really for the many Pokémon\nyou’ll find living here, adapted for such weather!

label: sdc02_0070_teacher_05
text: One such species has even grown exceptionally\nlarger than it might in other regions, thanks to all\r\nthe light it’s exposed to here!

label: sdc02_0070_teacher_06
text: That’s right, certain species of Pokémon can have\ncompletely different appearances depending on\r\nthe region! We call this variation a [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]regional form[VAR 0xFF00(0000)].

label: sdc02_0070_teacher_07
text: And that brings us to today’s task.\c\nI’d like each of you to catch one of these\nPokémon—specifically, an [VAR 0xFF00(0006)]Alolan Form[VAR 0xFF00(0000)] Pokémon!

label: sdc02_0070_teacher_08
text: When you’ve got one, come and report to me.

label: sdc02_0070_teacher_09
text: Now, get catching!

label: sdc02_0070_fairybb_05
text: Many of our classes here at Blueberry Academy\nare practical ones like this.[VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0070_fairybb_06
text: So off you go! Don’t overthink it and just do your\nbest for this first class![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0070_fairybb_07
text:
Do you know what kind of Pokémon it is you’re
supposed to be looking for?\c
I suppose the best-known Alolan form might be
Alolan Exeggutor, with its long, long neck![VAR 0x0114(0049)]

label: sdc02_0070_mob_01
text: Do you know about the Dugtrio in Alola?\nThey’ve got these, like, crazy whiskers?!\r\nFeels weird to call them that, though.

label: sdc02_0070_mob_02
text: In the tropical Alola region, it’s quite common\nto greet people by calling out “Alola!”

label: sdc02_0070_mob_03
text: Now, which Pokémon had Alolan forms...? I think\nI remember a couple...
